mapper.select: select w.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone from hys_withdraw w left join hys_member m on m.member_id = w.member_id where w.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId}
select w.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone from hys_withdraw w left join hys_member m on m.member_id = w.member_id where w.member_id = #{memberId} order by w.withdraw_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into hys_withdraw (member_id, amount_cents, fee_cents, arrive_cents, bank_info, status, audit_by, audit_time, remark, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{amountCents}, #{feeCents}, #{arriveCents}, #{bankInfo}, #{status}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_withdraw set status = #{status}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, remark = #{remark} where withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and status = 'AUDITING'
